standard.summary: 由顶栏启用 TurboCore 后生效。profile=性能分析；native_experimental=实验性加速。默认关闭。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Effective once TurboCore is enabled from the top bar. profile = performance analysis; native_experimental = experimental acceleration. Off by default.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 由顶栏启用 TurboCore 后生效。profile=性能分析；native_experimental=实验性加速。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Takes effect only after TurboCore is enabled in the top bar. profile = performance analysis; native_experimental = experimental acceleration. Off by default.
